issues.description: The type of StockIngredient.price is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation use an int price, whereas the template StockIngredient declares price as double. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected type (and method signatures like getPrice()) and may cause type-related errors when they implement SealSaloon methods that rely on integer prices.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the StockIngredient.price type consistent across all artifacts. Update the template StockIngredient to use an int price (change the field, constructor parameter, and getPrice() return type to int) so it matches the UML in the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, if a double price is intended, update the problem statement and the solution to specify double for price.
